d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Senior Contract Specialist is responsible for the administration, commercial management, and governance of project contracts throughout the contract lifecycle. The role supports the development, tendering, award, execution, change management, claims administration, and close-out of project contracts, ensuring that contractual obligations are effectively managed and the project's commercial interests are protected.

The position supports the management of contracts placed by the project on either Worley paper or Customer paper, including engineering, procurement, construction, fabrication, specialist services, consultancy agreements, and other third-party contracts required for project delivery. The role does not include ownership, administration, or management of the prime contract between Worley and Customer.

Working closely with the Contract Manager and Project Management Team, the Senior Contract Specialist provides subject matter expertise in contract administration, commercial management, contract compliance, change management, and claims management to support successful project execution.
q: Professional certifications in Contract Management, Commercial Management, Quantity Surveying, Procurement, or Project Management.
Membership of a recognised professional body.
